Loss report: gha -> forgejo
[emulated] pipeline/ci pipeline.concurrency: concurrency group per run (Forgejo cancels earlier push and pull_request runs while concurrency is unset; the source had no concurrency, so each run gets its own group)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/release step.action: inline child jobs (the child pipeline .github/workflows/deploy.yml runs inline as jobs release-apply, release-plan; a return to GitHub Actions restores the call and the child file only with the round-trip metadata)
